mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_borrow_record (user_id, book_id, borrow_date, due_date, status, renew_count, fine_amount) VALUES (#{userId}, #{bookId}, #{borrowDate}, #{dueDate}, #{status}, #{renewCount}, #{fineAmount})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_borrow_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND book_id = #{bookId} AND status IN (0, 2) LIMIT 1
SELECT br.*, b.book_name, b.author FROM t_borrow_record br LEFT JOIN t_book b ON br.book_id = b.id WHERE br.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY br.status = 2 DESC, br.status = 0 DESC, br.borrow_date DESC

SELECT br.*, b.book_name, b.author FROM t_borrow_record br LEFT JOIN t_book b ON br.book_id = b.id WHERE br.user_id = #{userId} AND br.status IN (0, 2) AND br.due_date <= DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) ORDER BY br.due_date ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_borrow_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status IN (0, 2)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_borrow_record WHERE user_id = #{userId}

where.if: AND (b.book_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.stu_or_job_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select:
SELECT br.*, b.book_name, b.author, u.real_name, u.username FROM t_borrow_record br LEFT JOIN t_book b ON br.book_id = b.id LEFT JOIN t_user u ON br.user_id = u.id
ORDER BY br.borrow_date DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_borrow_record br LEFT JOIN t_book b ON br.book_id = b.id LEFT JOIN t_user u ON br.user_id = u.id
mapper.update: UPDATE t_borrow_record SET status = 2 WHERE status = 0 AND due_date < NOW()
UPDATE t_borrow_record SET due_date = #{dueDate}, renew_count = renew_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
UPDATE t_borrow_record SET return_date = #{returnDate}, status = IF(#{fineAmount} > 0, 3, 1), fine_amount = #{fineAmount} WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN (0, 2)
mapper.select: SELECT br.*, b.category_id, b.book_name FROM t_borrow_record br LEFT JOIN t_book b ON br.book_id = b.id WHERE br.user_id = #{userId} AND br.borrow_date >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) ORDER BY br.borrow_date DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_borrow_record WHERE status IN (0, 2)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_borrow_record WHERE status = 2
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_borrow_record WHERE status = 0 AND due_date BETWEEN NOW() AND DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)
